* 2 tablespoons agave nectar
* 1 tablespoon tamari
* Salt and pepper to taste

5. In a small bowl, whisk together the apple cider vinegar, agave nectar, and tamari. Pour the mixture over the kale and almond butter in the pan and stir-fry for another minute, until the sauce has thickened slightly.
6. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
7. Serve the kale and almond butter stir-fry hot, garnished with chopped nuts or seeds if desired.
